Harpreet Singh
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Ahmedabad
harpreet.singh807@example.com | +91 9368160553

Analytical digital marketing leader with a focus on performance-driven acquisition and organic search growth. Combines hands-on SEM and SEO execution with data-driven measurement using Google Analytics to improve funnel conversion and reduce CAC. Comfortable coordinating cross-functional teams via Git, Jira and Confluence; available with a 60 days notice period.

Experience

Bluefin Logistics — Dec 2023 - Present
Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Hybrid)
- Led SEM campaigns across Google Ads accounts, optimizing bidding and creatives to reduce cost-per-lead by 28% while increasing qualified lead volume by 42% in six months using A/B testing and conversion tracking.
- Drove SEO initiatives targeting transactional and local keywords, improving organic sessions by 35% and raising top-10 keyword count by 48% through technical fixes and content optimization.
- Implemented Google Analytics event tracking and attribution models to attribute 62% more conversions to paid search and organic channels; used insights to reallocate 18% of monthly ad spend to higher-performing campaigns.
- Coordinated campaign deployments and documentation using Git for landing page version control and managed task workflows in Jira and Confluence to streamline handoffs between marketing and engineering.

Finlytics — Oct 2022 - Nov 2023
SEO Specialist (Remote)
- Executed on-page and technical SEO improvements that increased organic MQLs by 54% year-over-year and raised organic revenue contribution by 30%.
- Managed Google Ads search campaigns for niche financial products, improving click-through-rate by 22% and lowering CPC by 15% through negative keyword refinement and ad copy iterations.
- Built and maintained Google Analytics dashboards to monitor channel performance and funnel drop-offs, enabling a 19% uplift in landing page conversion after targeted optimizations.
- Documented processes and SEO playbooks in Confluence and coordinated ticketed SEO fixes with engineering via Jira.

Cognizant — Jun 2021 - Sep 2022
Digital Marketing Manager (Onsite)
- Led SEO strategy for enterprise web properties, driving a 40% increase in organic traffic across priority pages via structured data, crawl budget optimization, and content pruning.
- Partnered with analytics teams to configure Google Analytics goals and segments, which identified high-value user cohorts and improved targeted re-engagement performance by 26%.
- Guided technical teams on SEO requirements using Git-based version control for site changes and tracked implementation status in Jira.
- Ran internal training sessions on SEO best practices and analytics interpretation, reducing reliance on external agencies and improving campaign velocity.

Helio Energy — Sep 2018 - May 2021
Performance Marketer (Hybrid)
- Managed SEM campaigns in Google Ads for lead generation, achieving a 33% decrease in cost-per-acquisition and a 2.1x increase in monthly leads through keyword expansion and bid strategy refinement.
- Implemented Google Analytics enhanced ecommerce and event tracking to measure lead qualification flow, uncovering a funnel bottleneck that when addressed improved lead-to-demo rate by 18%.
- Performed regular technical SEO audits and collaborated with development teams to resolve crawl errors and improve site speed, contributing to a 27% boost in organic traffic.
- Used Jira for campaign task tracking and documented processes in Confluence to maintain knowledge continuity.

Projects
- Local SEO Revamp (Side project): Performed a structured local SEO audit and implemented citation cleanup, GMB optimization and on-page local schema; achieved top-3 local pack placement for five target locations within 3 months.
- Landing Page Experimentation Toolkit: Built a lightweight Git-based workflow to version landing page experiments and combined results with Google Analytics conversion tracking to standardize A/B testing across teams.

Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, SEM
Tools: Git, Jira, Confluence

Education
CA, ICAI

Notice period: 60 days
